skill.name: pdf-analyze
skill.description: PDF automation skill for extracting text and tables, creating and modifying documents, converting pages to images, and filling PDF forms with validation helpers.
skill.summary: Process, inspect, and fill PDF files with practical automation workflows.
skill.author: 21pounder

security_audit.summary: Most static external command and network alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, comments, or reference URLs. The real risk is expected local file I/O in helper scripts that write PDFs or JSON to caller-supplied paths. No evidence of prompt injection, credential access, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts can overwrite caller-supplied output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Reject existing output paths unless a force flag is present, and resolve writes inside a user-approved working directory.

remediation.issue: Input PDF paths are accepted without file type or size checks.
remediation.suggestion: Validate extensions, handle parser errors, and document that untrusted PDFs should be processed in a restricted workspace.

remediation.issue: Documentation mixes examples with executable local workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Label which commands create files, list dependencies, and tell users to review generated PDFs before use.

content.value_statement: Manual PDF workflows are slow when users need text, tables, pages, or forms from complex documents. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical PDF recipes and helper scripts for extraction, conversion, and form filling.
actual_capabilities: Extracts PDF text, metadata, and tables using pypdf and pdfplumber workflows.
Merges, splits, rotates, watermarks, encrypts, and decrypts PDFs with documented tools.
Converts PDF pages to PNG images with an included helper script.
Detects fillable form fields and exports field metadata for review.
Fills PDF form fields or adds text annotations to non-fillable forms.
Creates validation images and checks bounding boxes before annotation.
limitations: Requires Python packages and some external PDF tools to be installed locally.
OCR examples need Tesseract and scan quality affects accuracy.
Non-fillable form placement depends on accurate visual bounding boxes.
Untrusted PDFs should be processed in a restricted workspace.

use_cases.title: Complete Recurring Forms
use_cases.description: Fill known PDF forms, validate field choices, and create reviewable output documents.

use_cases.title: Extract Document Data
use_cases.description: Pull text, metadata, and tables from reports for analysis or spreadsheet cleanup.

use_cases.title: Automate PDF Assembly
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, watermark, and generate PDFs as part of repeatable workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Key Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pdf-analyze skill to extract text from this PDF. Summarize the main sections and note any missing or unreadable pages.

prompt_templates.title: Pull Tables
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pdf-analyze skill to find tables in this PDF. Return a clean summary of each table and flag cells that need manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pdf-analyze skill to inspect this PDF form, identify fillable fields, fill them with my provided values, and create a review copy.

prompt_templates.title: Build a PDF Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pdf-analyze skill to design a repeatable workflow that extracts pages, validates form placement, fills fields, and produces final PDFs.

output_examples.input: A user provides a report PDF and asks for tables and section summaries.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists each detected table, summarizes document sections, and notes pages where extraction quality was weak.

output_examples.input: A user provides a fillable form and values for each visible field.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies form fields, applies valid values, reports any invalid choices, and creates a filled review PDF.

output_examples.input: A user needs selected pages merged with a watermark and password protection.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes the page operations, creates the combined PDF, and reports the generated file names for review.

best_practices: Work on copies of PDFs and keep original documents unchanged.
Review generated PDFs visually before sending or signing them.
Use a restricted workspace when processing PDFs from unknown sources.
anti_patterns: Do not run helper scripts on sensitive PDFs outside an approved workspace.
Do not assume OCR output is complete without manual review.
Do not overwrite original PDFs with generated outputs.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable fields and annotation-based filling for non-fillable forms.

faq.question: Does it support scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, through OCR examples. OCR requires extra tools and accuracy depends on scan quality.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pdfplumber workflows for table extraction and cleanup.

faq.question: Does it need local dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. Some workflows require Python packages, Poppler tools, Tesseract, qpdf, or pdftk.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential PDFs?
faq.answer: Use an approved local workspace and review files before sharing. The included scripts do not make network calls.

faq.question: Can it create new PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes reportlab and pdf-lib examples for creating and modifying PDFs.
